content.text: {"id": "mm7316a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Out of the 145,690 doses shipped from the stockpile through 2023, 95% (139,120) have been repurposed for preventive vaccination"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "All requests to ICG for outbreak response (three of 11) were delivered within 1 week of being received."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The number of doses shipped from the stockpile has increased annually, from 4,800 doses in 2021, to 13,870 doses in 2022"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Most doses shipped (139,120; 95%) were repurposed for preventive vaccination."}]}, {"v": "continuous", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Longer times to delivery were noted for shipments intended for preventive vaccination"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "A total of 145,690 doses have been shipped from the ICG stockpile since 2021."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "95% (139,120) have been repurposed for preventive vaccination, and 5% (6,570) were used in outbreak response."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "This report describes the use of Ebola vaccines and the role of the stockpile"}]}, {"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The ICG Ebola vaccine stockpile reached the goal of 500,000 doses in 2022"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Information on Ebola vaccine stockpile requests and deliveries during 2021–2023 was obtained from the ICG Secretariat."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Outbreak data obtained from the World Health Organization Regional Office for Africa weekly Outbreak and Emergencies situation reports was compared with data from CDC"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["outcome_types", "study_design"]}
